message.content: {"caption":"Comparison of fixed memory access with an agentic memory system for LLM agents.","description":"Two side-by-side schematic panels. In both, an environment interacts with an LLM agent. In the traditional system, the agent writes to and reads from a separate memory store shown as three stacked blocks. In the proposed system, the agent writes to and reads from an agentic memory component, which is linked by multiple bidirectional arrows to three memory blocks, suggesting more flexible memory operations.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
